dataset: TCD-TIMIT only; frontal volunteer recordings; three lipspeakers unavailable
schedule: one epoch linear warmup then cosine decay
loss: author 0.1 CTC + 0.9 attention; original 0.1 label smoothing
batchnorm: frozen running statistics; affine parameters trainable
augmentation: author random spatial crop 88 and AdaptiveTimeMask(10,25)
selection: lowest validation WER; earlier checkpoint wins ties; include original baseline
test_policy: no test gradients or model selection; evaluate baseline and selected model after selection
prior_test_exposure: No TCD-TIMIT test evaluation before checkpoint selection
pretraining_history: Original author checkpoint; no LRS2/LRS3 project-adapted weights transferred
migration: Separate TCD-TIMIT run; original author weights and fresh optimizer
validation_origin: Speaker-disjoint TCD-TIMIT partition pinned before evaluation
changed_from_lrs3: Dataset adapter only; reuse existing batched LRS2 training recipe
order: seeded shuffle; length-sort pools of 256; shuffle full four-clip batches; partial batch last
augmentation_rng: SHA256(seed:epoch:clip_id); independent of workers and prefetch
padding: zero normalized input; encoder/decoder attention masks; pre-depthwise Conformer mask; true CTC lengths
accumulation: per-utterance weighting including partial final update
preprocessing_failure_policy: Retain failed test clip as empty prediction for baseline and selected model
